name: Oooku Maruhi Monogatari
source:
Main character is a female who comes to the inner chambers of Ooku castle in search of her master favor. She performs various tasks with the ultimate aim of giving birth to a child.

[From [url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主人公是一名进入大奥的女子，她渴望获得主君的宠爱。她需要完成各种任务，最终目标则是为主君生下子嗣。

[引自[url=http://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/04/vn-of-year-1983.html]vndbreview[/url]]
